irrbbDisclosureNote: National Bank discloses IRRBB via a single 'Interest Rate Sensitivity - Non-Trading Activities (Before Tax)' table, published every quarter in the Report to Shareholders MD&A Risk Management section (and annually in the Annual Report), rather than the full Basel/OSFI six-scenario standardized framework (parallel up/down, steepener, flattener, short-rate up/down) some larger Canadian peers disclose. It shows only one prescribed shock: an immediate and sustained parallel +/-100bp shift in interest rates. Both Economic Value of Equity impact and projected 12-month Net Interest Income impact are shown, before tax, split between Canadian-dollar and other-currency books, calculated daily and assuming no further hedging. Unlike the Basel IRRBB outlier-test convention (15% of Tier 1/CET1), National Bank reports these sensitivities strictly in absolute CAD-millions dollar terms, never as a percentage of any capital base; its own Supplementary Regulatory Capital and Pillar 3 Disclosure package explicitly cross-references the IRRBB disclosure to specific pages of the Report to Shareholders/Annual Report rather than including a standalone Basel IRRBB1 template of its own.
